facts.text: Maria volunteered at a shelter on Last Friday, spending time at the front desk.

evidence.quote: Last Friday, I spent some time at the shelter volunteering at the front desk.

facts.text: Maria observed people at the shelter receiving food or a bed, which made her feel good.

evidence.quote: Seeing the smiles on their faces when they got food or a bed really made me feel good.

facts.text: John expressed appreciation for Maria's support and acknowledged the impact of kindness on people's lives.

evidence.quote: Maria, I'm glad you're finding fulfillment there. It's amazing how a little kindness can have such a big impact on someone's life.

facts.text: John mentioned that donations helped acquire a brand new fire truck, which is parked in a garage with other vehicles.

evidence.quote: The donations even helped get a brand new fire truck!
Look at that - we all donated for it, and it looks awesome!
Together, our impact will surely last.
